outlook.statement: Global growth projected to slow to 2.5% in 2026 from 2.9% in 2025; EMDE growth expected to slow to 3.6%. India continued to remain one of the fastest-growing major economies during FY 2025-26, supported by strong domestic demand, robust public capex, resilient manufacturing, improving private investment, and policy reforms. Government initiatives such as Make in India, PM Gati Shakti, and continued infrastructure investments have strengthened industrial growth and enhanced India's long-term economic outlook.

The outlook for the textile and geogrid businesses remains positive, supported by increasing domestic consumption, infrastructure development, Government policy support, technical textile initiatives, and expanding manufacturing capabilities. The Company intends to continue strengthening operational efficiencies, enhancing product quality, expanding market presence, and exploring new business opportunities to achieve sustainable long-term growth.
